provenance: Independently hand-derived from the Harvey & Liu 2015 multiple-testing haircut (Decision D3, resolved 2026-05-22). 'Backtesting', Journal of Portfolio Management 42(1), DOI 10.3905/jpm.2015.42.1.013. Pipeline per trial i over N trials: (1) t_i = Sortino_i * sqrt(T_i) where T_i is that trial's return-observation count; (2) one-sided p_i = 1 - Phi(t_i), standard-normal survival (large-sample approximation; Harvey & Liu use the normal for large samples); (3) Benjamini-Hochberg step-up adjustment across the N raw p-values: sort p ascending, p_adj_(k) = min over j>=k of [ N/j * p_(j) ], clamp to [0,1]; (4) selection: argmin p_adj_i, gated by p_adj_i <= q. Every t/p/p_adj value below was computed in Python with scipy.stats.norm.cdf and the BHY step-up by hand — NO producer (autotuner) output is used. The tolerance for matching these values in tests is 1e-9 absolute: the pipeline is deterministic; larger error means a wrong formula, not float rounding. Sortino and T inputs are scenario design choices, not producer values.
fdr_q_comment: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate level. Conventional 0.05. In the autotuner this must be a NAMED policy-dial constant (e.g. HARVEY_LIU_FDR_Q) with a sourced comment; the fixture pins q=0.05 only so the cleared-set assertions are reproducible.

mixed_one_clear_winner.description: Five trials spanning strong / mid / weak / marginal / negative skill. A_strong is the unambiguous BHY winner (smallest p_adj); A_strong and A_mid clear the q=0.05 gate. No raw p underflows to 0.0 — chosen so the haircut math is exercised without hitting the p-value clamp.

noise_only_none_clears.description: Six pure-noise trials: small both-sign Sortino values consistent with a zero-skill strategy's sampling variation. After BHY adjustment NO trial clears q=0.05 (min p_adj ~= 0.7512). This is the overfitting-protection property: the haircut must reject the ENTIRE noise set so the AI proposal falls through to the fallback/default cascade.

one_signal_among_noise.description: One genuinely skilled trial (C_signal, large t-stat) among five noise trials. Only C_signal clears q=0.05 and is the BHY winner. Companion to noise_only_none_clears: proves the gate is not so strict it rejects a real signal.
